newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS AND BAT V DERBYSHIRE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS AND BAT V DERBYSHIRE.

text.p: Australia won the toss and elected to bat in their three-day match against Derbyshire starting on Saturday.
Derbyshire - Michael May, Adrian Rollins, Chris Adams, Dean Jones (captain), Ian Blackwell, Vincent Clarke, Karl Krikken, Phil DeFreitas, Andy Harris, Kevin Dean, Paul Aldred.
Australia - Mark Taylor (captain), Matthew Elliott, Justin Langer, Steve Waugh, Michael Bevan, Greg Blewett, Ian Healy, Shane Warne, Andrew Bichel, Jason Gillespie, Brendon Julian.
